interest: Debate over whether the U.S. or the Far Eastern Commission should decide on Indochina gold earmarked in Japan.
overview: Memorandum of November 27, 1947 from Jackson and Wallner to Whitman: title to gold earmarked in Japan for Indochina is a political question for the Far Eastern Commission.

subfiles.about: A memorandum stating EUR and WE's position that the recognition of title and return of Indochina gold should be referred to the Far Eastern Commission rather than decided unilaterally.
subfiles.from: EUR: Wayne G. Jackson; WE: Woodruff Wallner
subfiles.summary: Jackson (EUR) and Wallner (WE) agree that title to Indochina gold earmarked in Japan is a political question for the Far Eastern Commission. They suggest revising the letter to Draper and having the French raise it with the FEC.
subfiles.title: Office Memorandum from EUR and WE to OE regarding Indochina Gold and the FEC
